text:
priya: kickoff — draft PRD for Smart Routing fallback capability. Need quick alignment on launch criteria and what customers get in v1. TL;DR: tiered fallbacks + region-aware variants.
liam: can we scope v1 to only CPU-backed model variants + 1 fallback tier? keeps runtime changes small.
mike: +1 to minimal runtime changes. but we need to define failure modes: OOM, queue timeouts, miscompilation.
karen: SLOs? what are acceptable latency regressions on fallback? customers will notice.
priya: propose acceptance criteria: 1) fallback triggers <10ms decision time, 2) end-to-end 95p latency increase <=30% for routed requests, 3) fallbacks produce compatible tokenization/formatting for callers. Thoughts?
ana: on "compatibility" — we need clear mapping of model-family fallbacks, and a regression test set (50 prompts) to validate output shape and hallucination deltas.
liam: agree. also need a compatibility matrix for {model_family -> fallback_variant} and an explicit "abort" list for incompatible pairs.
priya: sample policy config we might ship (pseudo):
```
{ "tiers": [
  {"name":"prod", "fallbacks":["redwood-ggml-xx","redwood-quant-small"]},
  {"name":"dev",  "fallbacks":["cpu-small"]}
] }
```
mike: runtime note: fallback to quantized variants requires KV cache format compatibility. if not compatible we should do stateless cold-start which impacts latency.
karen: acceptance criteria addition: cold-start fallback must not exceed 2x baseline p95 latency and must be rate limited. add to PRD.
liam: edge case: model pinned by customer. If pinned and fallback incompatible, what do we do? rollback policy or return explicit 409? we need product call.
priya: plan: for pinned models, return 409 with clear error + telemetry + recommend compatible variant list. Add to TODO for UX team.
ana: test plan: unit tests for routing logic, integration with runtime on staging, and golden eval against the 50-prompt suite. flag quality regressions >5 BLEU-like change.
mike: ops checklist: flagging, circuit breaker, metrics: fallback_count, fallback_latency, fallback_quality_regressions.
priya: prioritization ask: can eng deliver minimal v1 (CPU compat + single-tier) by EOD sprint+2? that's 3 weeks.
liam: sprint+2 doable if we cut the region-aware routing to post-launch. keep region sharding out of v1.
priya: OK mark region-aware as v1.5. update PRD with acceptance bullets and owner assignments.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: feature/route-fallback-checks -> staging @ 1768456805 :white_check_mark:
karen: I'll run chaos test on staging tomorrow and report any SLO regressions.
priya: thanks — I'll update the PRD and ping ux + legal for customer messaging.
liam: will draft compatibility matrix by EOD.
ana: I'll assemble the 50-prompt eval set, leaning on recent customer prompts. expect PR by Friday.
priya: perfect. next sync if blockers show in staging. :thumbsup:
